deploybot: Infra apply started — environment: prod-dc3, workspace=prod-gpupool, run_id=r-0a1b2c3, author=chris, commit=c5d4e2 (tag=v1.6.7). Planned changes: +3 resources, ~2 changed, -0. Plan: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/r-0a1b2c3

maria: @deploybot can we hold? QA canary still running, seeing intermittent 502s on /v1/predict. timing feels bad.

aj: noted. this plan pins provider to hashicorp/aws@4.45.0 and adjusts autoscaling. should be low risk. if QA asks hold we can pause.

chris: maria — are the 502s correlated with scale events? i don't think scaling will cause sg changes. any smoke logs?

maria: intermittent, not tied to scaling. it's probably an unrelated flake but prefer to avoid churn. can we target only provider pin for now: `-target=provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"]` ?

aj: ok pausing apply — running `deploybot pause r-0a1b2c3`

deploybot: Hold placed on run r-0a1b2c3 by @aj. Apply paused.

(5m)
aj: QA gave manual smoke green. resuming.

deploybot: Infra apply resumed by @aj — applying changes now. streaming logs: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/r-0a1b2c3/logs

deploybot: Apply complete for run r-0a1b2c3 — 3 added, 2 changed, 0 destroyed. Duration 2m12s. Provider pinned to hashicorp/aws v4.45.0. Outputs: gpupool_size=64. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/r-0a1b2c3/logs#apply

chris: saw a brief 502 spike ~30s after resume, recovered quickly. tagging for follow-up if it recurs. @sre-bot

kyle: looking — transient backend reconnects during rolling restart, no persistent failures. no rollback now.

aj: leaving rollback rule: if errors >1% sustained for 5m we rollback to tag v1.6.6 (rollback procedure: `terraform state rm && redeploy v1.6.6` documented in runbook).

sre-bot: oncall-notify: @sre_oncall alerted for observation.
